import java.io.*
import java.util.*

fun <T : Comparable<T>> max(a: T, b: T): T = if (b > a) b else a
fun <T : Comparable<T>> min(a: T, b: T): T = if (b < a) b else a
fun Number.isEven(): Boolean = if (this.toInt() and 1 == 0) true else false
fun Number.isOdd (): Boolean = !this.isEven()

fun main(args: Array<String>) {
    if (args.isNotEmpty()) System.setIn(FileInputStream(args[0]))
    val br = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(System.`in`))
    val bw = BufferedWriter(OutputStreamWriter(System.out))

    val st = StringTokenizer(br.readLine())
    val n = st.nextToken().toInt()
    val m = st.nextToken().toInt()
    val arr = Array(n) { CharArray(m) }
    for (i in arr.indices) {
        val st = StringTokenizer(br.readLine())
        arr[i] = st.nextToken().toCharArray()
    }
    val modu = (1e9 + 7).toInt()
    var answer = 1L
    for (i in arr[0].indices) {
        answer *= arr.map { it[i] }.distinct().count()
        answer %= modu
    }

    bw.write("$answer\n")
    bw.close()
}
